message.content: Based on the discussion between LiHua and Emily Burnett, it appears that LiHua is particularly drawn to the exploration of free will and choice in Westworld. This theme resonates deeply with him, as evidenced by his comments about the show’s ability to challenge perceptions of reality and morality. LiHua finds the ethical implications of creating sentient beings to be particularly relevant and raises questions about the nature of free will, which aligns closely with the central theme of free will and choice explored in the show.
